title: Mistral launches open-weight AI model ML4 to rival top systems
summary: Mistral launches ML4 open-weight AI model to compete with top systems
detailed: French AI startup Mistral unveiled its new open-weight AI model, Mistral Large 4, publicly nicknamed "Le Chonk."
The model was introduced at an event in Abu Dhabi with a full public release scheduled for October 27.
Prior to public launch, cybersecurity experts and government authorities will receive access to a version with reduced safety restrictions for capability evaluation.
Mistral claims the model ranks among the strongest open-weight systems and narrows the gap with leading U.S. closed models.
